name: file-attachment
description: Expands @filepath references in user input to file contents in <file-include> format

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

maxFileSize.description: Deprecated alias for the root uploadLimits.maxFileSize (the root key wins when both are set). Maximum file size in bytes to expand for text files (root default: 100KB).

maxImageSize.description: Deprecated alias for the root uploadLimits.maxImageSize (the root key wins when both are set). Maximum image size in bytes to attach on @refs (root default: 10MB).

maxFiles.description: Deprecated alias for the root uploadLimits.maxFiles (the root key wins when both are set). Maximum number of files to expand per input.
